tasks.short: Determine whether new RFID technologies are useful.

steps.what: Define the actual tracking use case, operating constraints and usefulness criteria
Inspect candidate tag and reader evidence for compatibility and performance limitations
Design a representative trial and specify read zones and success criteria
Perform the physical RFID trial under actual material and interference conditions
inputs: trial tags, reader and representative goods
outputs: actual RFID trial observations and reader logs

steps.what: Capture and check actual attempts, expected identifiers, observed reads and conditions
inputs: actual RFID trial observations and reader logs

steps.what: Calculate observed read coverage and false-read counts by checked trial condition
Judge usefulness and write and approve the final technology evaluation
File the approved RFID usefulness evaluation

tasks.design: Use a native spreadsheet pivot/calculation on separately captured actual RFID trial results. Keep requirement definition, source evaluation, trial design, physical trials and usefulness judgement full time. The specialist writes/checks the final evaluation before a separate filing action. No automated technology selection or production reader setting change.
tasks.previous_blocker: A vendor read-range claim does not show performance around the actual goods and interference.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit trial attempts and observed reads permit transparent arithmetic by condition.
tasks.still_hard: Representative tests and operational usefulness require physical and engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Detect a trial setup that hides missed reads or reads from the wrong zone.
tasks.altitude: Small result-handling savings within human RFID evaluation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit RFID trial results can be counted and compared by condition using spreadsheet formulas and pivots.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual manual counting/filing; existing trial-analysis tools earn no new benefit. No read-rate baseline is invented.

Specialist produces requirements and trial plan in s1/s3. Reader produces actual logs during s4; specialist observes actual attempts and conditions. s5 captures/checks trial_id, expected_tag_id, observed_tag_id, attempt_count, read_count, timestamp and condition at full time. Missing ground truth requires manual investigation, not assumed successful reads.

s6 performs explicit counts/ratios only; s7 retains interpretation and writes/checks final usefulness conclusion. a1 binds that completed document; edits revoke approval. Native trial tooling and spreadsheet features precede code.
research_questions: Can the current trial tool already compare expected and actual reads by the specialists defined conditions?

approvals.approved_version: s7 final usefulness evaluation and trial references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional scenario range from checked RFID trial arithmetic, version-matched native training aids, diagram templates or maintained research searches, minus focal upkeep. Low assumes partial coverage. Actual trials, training, capture, interpretation, procedure writing and routine file saves or sends retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train users in RFID system operation.

steps.what: Assess user needs and select the actual RFID workflows to teach
inputs: actual user duties and system version

steps.what: Prepare version-matched training aids using selected approved screens and operating instructions
inputs: approved RFID operating instructions and screen examples

steps.what: Demonstrate RFID operation and coach users through representative practice
Assess actual user handling and explain missed-read or exception recovery
outputs: actual user learning outcomes and follow-up needs

steps.what: Write and approve actual attendance, outcomes and follow-up training notes
inputs: actual user learning outcomes and follow-up needs

steps.what: Commit the approved actual RFID training record

tasks.design: Configure a native training-aid template from selected approved operating steps and version-matched screen examples. Retain user assessment, instruction and practical coaching. Capture actual attendance and outcomes after teaching, approve the full record, then commit it separately in {LMS}. Practice uses a training reader/sandbox and does not change live tracking records.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generic guide cannot identify whether a user can handle a real missed-read exception.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled templates reduce repeated copying of already-approved operating details.
tasks.still_hard: User understanding and practical recovery require observation and coaching.
tasks.human_edge: Notice the misunderstanding that causes a user to repeat a bad scan procedure.
tasks.altitude: Less aid assembly with unchanged practical instruction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document templates can reuse approved training instructions and matched screenshots while an instructor retains selection and checking.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual aid copying and record posting; current templates earn no new benefit.

s1 specialist captures user needs in retained time. Existing system/document owners supply approved instructions and versioned screen examples; s2 specialist selects IDs, steps and examples, adapts/checks the complete aid in retained 9 hours per provisional 100. Absent current sources requires manual aid preparation.

s3/s4 specialist observes actual attendance and learning; s5 separately captures session_id, user_id, actual attendance, demonstrated operations, exception needs and follow-up at full time after instruction. No planned enrolment is treated as completion.
a1 binds the final s5 record; edits revoke approval. Native document and LMS features precede code. No live RFID transactions or additional training invitations are sent.
research_questions: Which repeated aid assembly remains after reusing the current approved version-specific instructions?

incremental.description: Check training-aid references when the RFID system changes

approvals.approved_version: s5 final actual attendance and outcome record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional scenario range from checked RFID trial arithmetic, version-matched native training aids, diagram templates or maintained research searches, minus focal upkeep. Low assumes partial coverage. Actual trials, training, capture, interpretation, procedure writing and routine file saves or sends retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop RFID process flows, work instructions and operating procedures.

steps.what: Observe actual RFID reads, handoffs and exception recovery in the workflow
inputs: actual RFID process and user practice

steps.what: Record checked actors, read zones, system states, handoffs and actual exception conditions
Design the process flow and assign explicit recovery and escalation responsibilities
outputs: specialist-designed RFID process and recovery flow

steps.what: Lay out process diagrams and standard instruction sections using selected controlled templates
inputs: specialist-designed RFID process and recovery flow
outputs: candidate RFID process and instruction layout

steps.what: Write actual operating details, exception steps and system-specific warnings
inputs: candidate RFID process and instruction layout

steps.what: Walk through and approve the complete procedure, version and intended internal users
Commit the approved RFID procedure to controlled document storage
Send the approved procedure version to its internal RFID users

tasks.design: Use controlled flow/instruction templates in {DOCS} for layout and exact selected metadata. The specialist observes, separately records actual RFID states and handoffs, designs the process, writes exceptions and walks through the complete procedure. Controlled filing and internal issue each have a gate on the final version. No model invents missed-read recovery logic.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generic procedure can hide real zone boundaries and responsibility gaps.
tasks.enabler_now: Native diagram and instruction templates reduce repeat layout of a human-designed process.
tasks.still_hard: Reliable recovery steps and workable handoffs require workflow expertise.
tasks.human_edge: Catch a recovery instruction that would create a duplicate or untracked item.
tasks.altitude: Less procedure layout with retained process design and validation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document and diagram templates can reuse controlled sections and render a specialist-defined process flow.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Establish actual repeated layout and issue work; existing templates earn no new benefit.

s1 specialist observes; s2 separately captures actor, operation, reader_zone, expected_tag_event, observed_state, next_owner and actual exception_condition at full time. System owner supplies current operation documentation. Missing behaviour is investigated in retained steps rather than assumed from a template.

s3 produces the actual ordered process and responsibilities. s4 retains 10.5 hours per provisional 100 for selecting/arranging/checking diagram elements; s5 writes all substantive instructions and warnings at full time. Native templates precede code.

s6 approves the completed procedure and recipients within existing authority before a1/a2 bind their destinations. Changes revoke approval. This creates/issues a procedure, not live RFID configuration changes.
research_questions: Which instruction layout work remains after native templates while preserving the actual RFID exception flow?

approvals.approved_version: s6 final procedure version and controlled storage
s6 final procedure version and internal recipients

tasks.short: Stay current through RFID literature, meetings, conferences and colleagues.

steps.what: Locate RFID research using maintained searches in the existing technical library
Read research and evaluate technical claims against actual RFID application conditions
Discuss new findings and unresolved RFID questions with colleagues
Attend research meetings or conferences and question relevant technical claims
inputs: actual RFID research meeting or conference

steps.what: Write and check research notes, source references and practical follow-up questions
Save the checked RFID learning note and sources

tasks.design: Configure native saved searches in the existing technical-library system ({OTHER}) for specialist-selected RFID questions. Retain source reading, colleagues and conference participation at full time. Research notes are separately written/checked and saved only after approval. A returned paper is not validated technical knowledge and no meeting is replaced by a generated summary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding a paper does not establish its relevance to the actual RFID environment.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved field searches reduce repeated library navigation while preserving original sources.
tasks.still_hard: Technical interpretation and knowledge gained through questions remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an assumption in a research result that does not hold in the intended installation.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation with retained learning and professional exchange.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: technical-library saved searches can retrieve indexed RFID papers from explicitly chosen query fields.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Establish current source-navigation and note-save effort; existing search alerts earn no new benefit.

Specialist produces/maintains terms, date range and field filters in retained s1 time, which includes screening and missing-source retrieval. Existing library supplies indexed metadata; no new tagging is assumed. Missing index coverage uses existing manual search.

s2 reading, s3 colleagues and s4 actual attendance stay full time. s5 separately captures source_id, claim, scope, discussion provenance, applicability and follow-up at full time. A conference is not treated as attended before it occurs.
a1 binds the completed checked note after s5; changes revoke approval. Native search and document features precede code. No external research message is sent.
research_questions: Which repeated research-navigation actions remain after the technical library uses maintained native searches?

incremental.description: Maintain RFID search fields and source coverage checks

approvals.approved_version: s5 completed learning note and source references

role.altitude: Use actual RFID observations and controlled records to support technology evaluation, teaching and process design.
reach: Help operators distinguish a planned workflow, a tested RFID behaviour and a recorded actual outcome.
role.ambitious_version: An RFID specialist who grounds decisions and operating guidance in observed behaviour and clearly controlled evidence.
